entries.origin_analysis: The user's broader Entry/Exit technical-factor request required M1/M5/M15/M30/H1 completed-bar oscillator and technical-state evaluation beyond HYP-025's price-only cells.
entries.causal_hypothesis: After price-path state is known, multi-timeframe oscillator, trend, volatility and bar-state features may add portable information for F05/B02 P3 establishment, P2 continuation failure or P1 giveback termination.
pre_result_predictions: at least one timeframe adds positive AUC in all four folds over price path
the incremental signal survives an enriched same-timeframe price-geometry baseline
a surviving cell saves more loser loss than Winner profit at a fixed non-optimized decision threshold
entries.decision: Close HYP-026 before portfolio replay, MT4 and 2025. Technical state is descriptive in limited cells but does not produce an economically valid portable rule after price geometry and Winner opportunity cost.
falsified_or_unsupported_claims: P1 oscillator deterioration is independent Exit alpha after price path is known
F05 P2 gains portable information from M1/M5/M15/M30/H1 technical indicators
B02 P2 M15 discrimination produces positive Exit economics
F05 first-M5 P3 discrimination preserves enough Winner profit to be actionable
retained_findings: F05 first-M5 technical state has a small robust incremental discrimination signal over enriched M5 geometry
that F05 signal loses 3978.1 Winner pips while saving 3706.7 loser pips and reduces pooled result by 271.4 pips
B02 P2 first-positive plus 15-minute M15 technical gain is statistically uncertain after bootstrap and loses 1952.4 pooled pips
P1 technical deterioration is a descriptive re-expression of price-state decay rather than independent portable information
B02 P3 cannot support a four-fold technical rule because 2024H2 has zero common-M1 P3 observations
prohibited_reuse: no indicator threshold or period grid
no side, session, year or fold exception
no HYP-025 cell repair or chaining
no MT4 or 2025 selection from HYP-026 outcomes
successor_questions: Can genuinely distinct recoverability or event-sequence information improve economics without using indicator thresholds or relabeling HYP-026 descriptive signals?
